menu.name: research-build

menu.chain: Grok research → Claude build → ChatGPT check

menu.name: collab
menu.description: Two agents work as a pair: one plans, the other improves the plan, the first does the work, and the second edits and checks it.
menu.chain: Claude plan → ChatGPT amend → Claude build → ChatGPT edit (check)

menu.name: versus
menu.description: Two agents each build their own answer from the task alone and review each other's, then you pick the winner.

menu.name: redteam

menu.chain: Claude build → ChatGPT attack → Cursor attack → Claude revise → ChatGPT check

menu.name: vote
menu.description: Three agents answer the same short question on their own; the majority wins, and a tie comes to you.
menu.chain: Claude vote → ChatGPT vote → Grok vote → tally
